What we do

Professional Cleaning Services

Engineered for deep fiber revitalization, dust mite reduction, and stain relief using advanced extraction equipment.

Hot Water Extraction

Carpet Cleaning

High-pressure hot water extraction reaches deep into carpet fibers to remove trapped soil, allergens, and high-traffic pathways.

  • Wall-to-wall rooms & carpeted stairs
  • Spot & stain pre-treatment
  • High-suction fast drying
Fabric Rejuvenation

Sofas & Sectionals

Gentle yet powerful upholstery extraction for standard sofas, L-shaped sectionals, loveseats, and fabric recliners.

  • Odor and body oil extraction
  • Cushion & crevice detailed vacuuming
  • Fabric color & texture brightening
Detailed Care

Upholstery Cleaning

Complete care for custom upholstered headboards, armchairs, ottomans, and delicate synthetic and woven furniture fabrics.

  • Upholstered headboards & benches
  • Delicate fiber pH-balanced rinsing
  • Prevents fabric water-marking
Rugs & Runners

Area Rugs

Dedicated cleaning for living room area rugs, runners, and decorative floor coverings to restore original patterns and softness.

  • Wool, synthetic & blended rugs
  • Edge and fringe careful detailing
  • Neutralizing pet dander & spills
Sanitization

Mattresses

Deep hygienic extraction of King, Queen, and Twin mattresses to extract sweat residues, dead skin flakes, and dust mites.

  • Allergen & micro-dust extraction
  • Spot stain relief & deodorizing
  • Healthier sleeping environment
Precision Clean

Dining & Accent Chairs

Detailed fabric cleaning for dining room chair sets, office desk chairs, and living room accent armchairs.

  • Dining sets (4, 6, 8+ chairs)
  • Food & drink spill removal
  • Wood frame protection during work

Comprehensive residential deep cleaning and routine maintenance for homes, condos, and vacation villas in Central Florida.

Why Choose Apollo

The Apollo Standard of Excellence

We combine heavy-duty professional extraction machinery with dedicated attention to detail on every piece of upholstery and carpet.

Deep Hot Water Extraction

Commercial high-lift suction and heated water extraction reaches deep beneath the fiber surface without drenching backing layers.

Eco-Friendly & Safe Products

pH-balanced solutions formulated to dissolve oils, soil, and stains while remaining completely non-toxic for families and pets.

Meticulous Attention to Detail

From tufted buttons and fabric crevices to fringe detailing on delicate rugs, no area is overlooked during our process.

Fast Drying Time

High-efficiency dual vacuum recovery pulls out over 90% of moisture on each pass, allowing fabrics and carpets to dry quickly.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our hot water extraction methods, drying times, and pet-safe products.

Hot water extraction uses temperature-controlled water injected under pressure into carpet or upholstery fibers to break down grease, trapped dirt, and allergens, followed immediately by high-vacuum extraction. Leading manufacturers recommend this method as it removes soil rather than driving it deeper.

Thanks to our high-suction extraction equipment, average drying time for carpets is between 4 to 8 hours, and upholstery is 3 to 6 hours depending on air circulation, room temperature, and humidity.

Yes, 100%. We utilize eco-friendly, biodegradable, and non-toxic cleaning agents designed specifically for residential homes. They leave zero harmful chemical residues and are safe for children and pets once dry.

Yes. We apply specialized enzymatic pre-treatments that break down uric acid crystals and organic compounds causing persistent pet odors and yellow stains, flushing them out cleanly.

Major carpet and furniture manufacturers recommend professional hot water extraction every 6 to 12 months to extend fiber life, preserve appearance, and eliminate allergens.

We ask that you remove small fragile items from tabletops and clear floor clutter (toys, shoes, cables). Our team takes care of pre-inspection, furniture protection, and the entire cleaning process.
